description: This file declares classes and interfaces for performing asynchronous DNS transactions, including DNS resolution, probing, and configuration within the Chromium project. It defines the DnsTransaction interface, DnsProbeRunner, and DnsTransactionFactory, along with related methods and constants.

classes.name: DnsTransaction
classes.description: Interface for performing a DNS transaction, including starting the query, retrieving hostname and type, and setting request priority.

classes.name: DnsProbeRunner
classes.description: Interface for managing DNS probe sequences, including starting probes and scheduling delays.

classes.name: DnsTransactionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating DNS transactions and DoH probe runners, managing DNS configuration and options.

methods.name: CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new DNS transaction for a specified hostname and query type, with parameters for logging, security, and timeout behavior.

methods.name: CreateDohProbeRunner
methods.description: Creates a DNS-over-HTTPS probe runner for all configured DoH resolvers.

methods.name: AddEDNSOption
methods.description: Adds an EDNS0 option to all DNS queries generated by the factory.

methods.name: GetSecureDnsModeForTest
methods.description: Returns the default SecureDnsMode used in the configuration, primarily for testing.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a DnsTransactionFactory instance using a given DnsSession.
